fluff.overview: Com Guard conventional infantry benefit from ComStar's access to preserved Star League technology, fielding weapons and equipment that match or exceed the standard issue of any Inner Sphere military, backed by the institutional discipline of the secular Order's professional military culture. Mechanized tracked Level I formations ride armored personnel carriers through terrain that would stop wheeled vehicles, providing all-terrain mobility with meaningful armor protection against battlefield hazards. These formations can advance alongside armored Level I units without falling behind on broken ground. Equipped with infantry-portable short-range missile launchers that provide anti-armor capability beyond what personal weapons can achieve, these troops can threaten light vehicles and battle armor at close range.
